lastResponse.text: You’re doing a great job helping her. Once you’re in Parenting and Childcare, tap Child Care results. Then tap the Filter icon, choose Low-cost and Subsidy, and apply it. Next, tap Sort and pick Availability soonest if it shows. Open a program card to share it, or tap Request Referral and send this note: “Need urgent low-cost or subsidy child care in Washington County for a toddler and kindergartener.”
